title: Invoice page shows raw numbers for money
body:
The invoice detail page renders the line item amounts and the total as plain numbers (`1499.5`). They should display as currency, matching the rest of the app.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each line item amount displays as currency
- The invoice total displays as currency
- The currency code comes from the invoice, not a hardcoded default

comments.body: Confirmed with finance: invoices can be USD, CAD or EUR, so please do not hardcode the symbol.
